messages.body: Draft board update attached: results against plan, the top three risks and the hiring plan.
Lead with the customer numbers. Keep it to two pages.
My list: field hiring, non-productive time and switchgear lead times. Happy to discuss.
Next check-in is set. KPIs first, then the growth initiatives.
Three items hold the {month:-1} close: revenue on open projects, retainage schedule and bank reconciliation. All should clear this week.
Two owners gave feedback at closeout. Faster schedule updates are the main ask.
Pipeline for the open roles is attached. Offers are out for two.
Open items for the {month:-1} close: revenue on open projects, retainage schedule and bank reconciliation.
Please send the {month:-1} pack when ready. P&L first if the rest takes longer.
Reminder: the compliance certificate is due with the next test.
Payroll ran 2.6% under plan last month. Detail by team is attached.
Draft 2 of next year's budget is in the finance folder. Revenue plan by line is updated.
Fieldwork dates are set. Please confirm the request list owners.
19 roles are still open across the company. Overtime covers the gap for now.
Please bring the KPI trend and the two biggest drivers to the review.
A supplier pushed delivery a week. I have a backup quote.
Notes from the safety walk are attached. Two follow-ups.
An owner escalated a schedule slip. I called them; we have a plan.
Overtime is running above plan. Can we review it at the weekly meeting?
Let us review the top deals by stage before the leadership meeting.
Thanks for the proposal. We have questions on scope and timing.
The updated proposal template is in the shared folder.
Notes from the last two losses: price on one, timing on the other.
Results from last month's campaigns are in the dashboard.
We plan to renew. Can we talk about adding services?
Addendum 2 is posted. It changes the generator size.
